extraction.teacher_style: The instructor provides a direct, step-by-step breakdown of fundamental boogaloo popping techniques in a casual indoor setting. He uses clear verbal instructions combined with demonstrations at regular and slowed tempos to explain isolation and body rolls.

lesson_structure.note: Demonstration of boogaloo and popping style outdoors.
Title card and introduction of the teacher.
Slow motion demonstration of double leg roll.
Boogaloo roll example combining double to single boog roll.
Teaching hip rolls and boogaloo hips.
Teaching boogaloo chest rolls and isolation.
General advice on practicing boogaloo style.

cues: Bend your knees a little bit
common_mistakes: Losing isolation when rolling legs too wide
Upper body moving too much when attempting lower body rolls

steps_taught.name: Basic double leg roll
steps_taught.description: Put feet together, bend knees slightly, and roll both knees forward and to the sides on toes.

steps_taught.name: Single leg rolls
steps_taught.description: Feet shoulder-width apart, rolling one leg at a time while maintaining isolation.

steps_taught.name: Hip Boogaloo Rolls
steps_taught.description: Moving hips side to side while isolating upper body, then rolling in a circle.

steps_taught.name: Boogaloo Chest
steps_taught.description: Moving chest forward, right, back, left, and forward in a fluid motion.

steps_taught.name: Head rolls
steps_taught.description: Rolling the head while coordinating with body and chest movement.

steps_taught.name: The Old Man
steps_taught.description: Shifting lower body and upper body in alternating diagonal parts.

what_works: Slow motion inserts clarify intricate leg and hip rolls
Breaking down movements into separate upper and lower body components
what_hinders: Lack of counts makes musical timing harder to follow
